result.keyword: What's the best project management tool for a startup?
result.markdown:
For most startups, **Linear is the best project management tool if you're building a tech product**, while **ClickUp is the best all-around option for a startup managing multiple departments.**

The right choice depends on your team's size, working style, and whether you're managing software development, marketing, operations, or everything at once.

Here's how I'd compare the strongest options.

## Best project management tools for startups

![Fast growing startups are built on Linear](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/piHpddRS6n9dTggcCRU3QzspXui7xfTg4qksC0xamyVTz0l5rmZLEYCGsVB7KKUouzfiOTbe-9ydzUq7UB2MFrNbZIGlaUSNjP0C8Bhd2CXnbxL2xZ05zw3USDTcATN8Ed4Fr3ygsGaA-sAB5VFRUeF1jd3BNolTylsoZGFQvpYkliFtHTL_AgaQh3gID9Z3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Linear**

(Best for tech startups)

- Excellent product roadmaps and sprint planning.
- Fast, clean interface.
- Great for engineering and product teams.
- Integrates with GitHub and developer workflows.

Website: [Linear](https://linear.app)

---

![ClickUp Review 2026: Honest In-Depth Analysis & Features](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/IhDLDOyxNDHrKHznRnMbzyjIK7Vr4N5HNf17bkJW7PnIqc3qMmYgJU2IqfzLiCBJatpbDtLiH4ToLtJwHlzGNnvDPQLGe5YS9YbILi94CXJmy4xFdhZmSjqz-lpCT9-ubZzBBG-nlRcQIsvn8DaSyQoEPl_3wXUG0qs9BW4SnIccpcG_XWfRoc5BRY_9ndY5?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. ClickUp**

(Best all-in-one solution)

- Tasks, documents, goals, and dashboards.
- Custom workflows and automations.
- Useful across marketing, sales, product, and operations.
- Can replace several separate tools.

Website: [ClickUp](https://clickup.com)

---

![Getting started with projects and tasks](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/rBzz0YucWqa7TzwsR7O0OijwcWtKRR6vUa-4dyys2qUThLtS4XfkdJkNbKUF7MlYIx2Pf95vz1ZwpmkGZkQkQJbR9XXSMKgQ3ynqVH_YRdhbdeiYO_anFWUt5rh2LV_lCuu0TZ7Njj7N3y1Z8_one9wjd1Cn5GmMKHW8zKADzpdtXUtH6f9EQMV9lVkrxAxK?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Notion**

(Best for early-stage startups)

- Combines documentation, knowledge bases, and task tracking.
- Great for company wikis and meeting notes.
- Flexible enough to build your own operating system.

Website: [Notion](https://notion.so)

---

![How to Set Up and Use Asana Portfolios for Better Project Management | Cirface](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/H9BdGlMyDzgBrRpDEr0Ynb6h_0_rpTdSbtEo-8xN-H4AnVrpxeTDynM-6GvpGogjqdBC72dw5fWqtxa7KcvbuYINGBkUAHvdW3agU4L3JNlfBnc3rrsVTy3ycSasDQbGBGWPT5sujj-EjLp4LT1Ml71Smw4H6BNlaO1BHtrasyshgIPeIoBavxM-YcekL-tG?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Asana**

- Excellent task ownership and accountability.
- Good project timelines and dependencies.
- Great for coordinating different departments.

Website: [Asana](https://asana.com)

---

![Portfolio management - All Projects Dashboard – Support](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/-5NH-hROEcQXpSQPmMUJv0x7GODAoqXeNRlBaAmeb5yjL6ws1fsUSsHXZKs7cGHwGwKjC6qsKZvaA0-fO7oD8-9_bc-PbX0_EJ1QpOPifoMbrdCVNNuollQzaJIhYGySdgXpxRYlPlDaiOA8sl0RXCUZIj48mjl4S_hb7oB4Rygmeul72nI4kZxZvS769XKO?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Monday.com**

- Very visual project tracking.
- Strong dashboards and automation.
- Good for growing teams with multiple departments.

Website: [Monday.com](https://monday.com)

These recommendations reflect the main differences highlighted in current 2026 startup software comparisons. ## My recommendation by startup stage

| Startup situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| 1–5 people, very early stage | Notion |
| 5–15 people, tech startup | Linear |
| 5–30 people, mixed departments | ClickUp |
| 15–50 people, scaling operations | Asana |
| Multiple teams and complex workflows | Monday.com |
